data.name: Danell
data.gender_notes: Danell is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Danell derives from Daniil, meaning 'God's judgment'. In Christian tradition, Danell represents the strength and wisdom of God, as well as the hope and faith that comes from trusting in His divine plan. The name Danell carries the meaning “God's judgment” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Danell usually hope their child will grow to embody god's judgment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the divine wisdom and judgment of God.
data.etymology: Danell belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's judgment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Danell total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: דנאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אל הוא שופטי, דן הוא אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דנאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אל הוא שופטי' או 'דן הוא אלוהים'. השם דנאל מורכב משתי מילים: 'דן' שפירושו 'שופט' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם דנאל מופיע בתנ"ך כהשם של אחד מבני ישראל.

in_greek.name: Ντανέλ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντανέλ είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος דנאל, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι ο δικαστής μου'. Το όνομα αυτό δεν εμφανίζεται άμεσα στη Βίβλο, αλλά η ετυμολογία του έχει βιβλική βάση.

in_latin.name: Danell
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Danell origine hebraicum est, quod significat 'Deus est iudex meus' vel 'Deus est iudex'. Nomen hoc in Biblia non invenitur, sed radix hebraica in scripturis sacris apparet.

in_english.name: Danell
in_english.long_meaning: The name Danell originates from the Hebrew name דנאל (Dan'el), meaning 'God is my judge' or 'God is my justice'. Although Danell is not directly mentioned in the Bible, its etymology is rooted in biblical Hebrew. The name Danell has been adopted in various Christian cultures, symbolizing divine judgment and justice.
